    SysMLAttributeType.bindTo(AttributeObserver observer)
    Binds this attribute to the specified attribute observer where binding consists of adding the observer to the attribute's set of observers and notifying the observers of a change thereby providing the observer an opportunity to initialize its attribute with this attribute, thereby initializing the "binding".
